title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
abstract: Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly. As an interaction unfolds, new goals and intermediate results prompt further queries about the same visual history. VideoJev therefore reuses visual computation through Cached inference for queries as they arrive and Joint inference for multiple queries in a single forward pass. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks, VideoJev-4B and VideoJev-35B-A3B improve mean mIoU over their backbones by 6.7 and 10.8 points, respectively, with measured inference speedups of $2.8$-$3.1\times$. On four video QA benchmarks, both achieve performance comparable to their backbones in Thinking mode, with measured inference speedups exceeding $100\times$. These results offer a unified, reusable decision interface for composing structured visual judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In Computer Vision and Neural Networks, today’s lecture is on VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction. Recent work such as VideoMind: A Chain-of-lora Agent for Temporal-Grounded Video Reasoning and LongVideoAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Long Videos reflects a move toward agents that reason over video. VideoJev takes a different route: it scores structured choices directly rather than generating every answer as text. Researchers from Nanjing University and JD.com contribute to this work. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在计算机视觉和神经网络这门课上，今天要讲的是VideoJev：用于视频理解与交互的系统一模型。最近的一些工作，比如VideoMind：用于时序定位视频推理的LoRA链式智能体，以及LongVideoAgent：基于长视频的多智能体推理，都反映出一种趋势，就是让智能体在视频上做推理。VideoJev走的是另一条路：它直接对结构化选项打分，而不是把每个答案都生成成文本。这项工作是南京大学和京东的研究人员共同完成的。好，Noah，你有什么问题？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why does scoring an answer directly matter if a language model can already generate one?
segments.zh: 教授您好，如果语言模型已经能生成答案了，为什么直接给答案打分还这么重要呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Because generation makes a small decision pass through a process designed to produce a sequence of words. If an agent only needs to choose an answer or locate an event, generating a timestamp or answer letter can add unnecessary computation. VideoJev keeps language-conditioned video understanding, but changes the output interface into direct scores. Its central claim is that this can make repeated decisions more efficient without giving up the semantic strengths of a pretrained multimodal model.
segments.zh: 因为生成会让一个很小的决策走完一整套为产出词序列而设计的流程。如果智能体只需要选一个答案或定位一个事件，生成时间戳或答案字母反而会带来不必要的计算。VideoJev保留了以语言为条件的视频理解，但把输出接口改成了直接打分。它的核心主张是，这样能让反复做出的决策更高效，同时又不放弃预训练多模态模型在语义上的优势。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So it is still using a language model, but asking it to judge candidates instead of write a response?
segments.zh: 所以它还是在用一个语言模型，只不过是让它去评判候选答案，而不是写出回答？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. VideoJev starts from either Qwen three point five four B, a dense model, or Qwen three point six thirty-five B A-three B, a mixture-of-experts model. It replaces the usual output head with a scoring head. That head compares representations for a candidate and for the overall query, producing a score. Think of it like a reviewer comparing several proposals against the same question, rather than drafting a new explanation for each one.
segments.zh: 没错。VideoJev 的起点要么是 Qwen 3.5 4B，一个稠密模型，要么是 Qwen 3.6 35B A3B，一个混合专家模型。它把通常的输出头换成了一个打分头。这个头会对比候选答案和整体查询的表示，给出一个分数。可以把它想成一个评审，拿同一道题去比较几份方案，而不是为每一份都重新写一段解释。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The same interface handles 2 tasks. For video question answering, candidates are answer choices, and the model scores each one; a softmax turns those scores into a choice. For temporal grounding, candidates represent intervals associated with pairs of video frames. The model estimates whether each interval belongs to the queried event. This shared formulation is the conceptual contribution: answer selection and localization become candidate-scoring problems, even though their training objectives and final decoding differ.
segments.zh: 同一个接口处理两个任务。在视频问答中，候选对象是各个答案选项，模型给每个选项打分，再用softmax把分数转成一个选择。在时序定位中，候选对象是与视频帧对相关联的时间区间，模型判断每个区间是否属于所查询的事件。这种共享的表述方式正是概念上的贡献：答案选择和定位都变成了候选打分问题，尽管它们的训练目标和最终解码方式并不相同。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The distinction from a system with a separate localizer and answer decoder is important. VideoJev uses a common scoring mechanism for intervals and answer options, while keeping task-specific supervision. Answer selection uses cross-entropy. Grounding uses binary cross-entropy for candidate intervals, plus a soft intersection-over-union objective that rewards coverage of the event as a whole. That additional objective matters because identifying a few relevant frames is not the same as predicting a useful complete interval.
segments.zh: 与那种把定位器和答案解码器分开的系统相比，这个区别很重要。VideoJev 对区间和答案选项采用统一的打分机制，同时保留各自任务的监督信号。答案选择用交叉熵。时序定位对候选区间用二元交叉熵，再加一个软交并比目标，用来奖励对整个事件区间的覆盖。这个额外的目标很关键，因为找出几帧相关画面，和预测出一个完整有用的区间，并不是一回事。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: One practical insight is reusing video computation. In cached inference, the video is encoded and prefixed once, then later queries reuse the stored computation. This suits an assistant that receives questions over time. In joint inference, several questions share a video prefix and are scored in one causal forward pass. Later questions can attend to earlier query text, but answers are not appended. It resembles keeping one prepared case file open while asking several independent questions about its contents.
segments.zh: 一个实用的思路是复用视频计算。在缓存推理中，视频只编码并加前缀一次，之后的查询复用已存储的计算结果。这很适合那种随着时间不断收到问题的助手。在联合推理中，多个问题共享同一个视频前缀，在一次因果前向传播中一起打分。后面的问题可以注意到前面查询的文本，但答案不会被追加进去。这就像把一份准备好的案卷一直摊开着，针对里面的内容问几个彼此独立的问题。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does sharing the prefix mean later questions can influence earlier decisions?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：共享前缀是不是意味着后面的问题会影响前面的判断？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The sequence is causal, so later questions cannot change earlier computations. The benefit is that multiple questions can reuse the shared video representation, and later query text can attend to earlier query text. Training adopts a corresponding shared-prefix layout. The results show small improvements for joint inference over cached inference in most reported comparisons, but the core efficiency benefit is reuse. It avoids treating every question as if the video had never been seen before.
segments.zh: 不能。这个序列是因果的，所以后面的问题无法改变前面的计算。好处在于，多个问题可以复用共享的视频表示，而且后面的查询文本可以关注到前面的查询文本。训练时也采用了相应的共享前缀布局。结果显示，在大多数报告的对比中，联合推理相比缓存推理有小幅提升，但核心的效率优势在于复用。它避免把每个问题都当成模型从没见过这段视频一样来处理。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A second enabling insight is the grounding decoder. At inference, VideoJev applies a fixed score threshold of 0.25, then selects a contiguous interval with the highest adjusted score. A linear-time procedure finds that interval, followed by lightweight processing to ensure a valid, nonempty span. This matters in practical systems: scores alone do not produce a usable timestamp. The decoding rule turns many local interval judgments into one coherent event span without requiring text generation.
segments.zh: 第二个关键洞见是定位解码器。推理时，VideoJev 采用固定的 0.25 分数阈值，然后选出调整后分数最高的连续区间。一个线性时间的过程会找出该区间，随后进行轻量处理，确保得到有效且非空的跨度。这在实用系统中很重要：光有分数并不能产生可用的时间戳。该解码规则将许多局部区间判断整合为一个连贯的事件跨度，而无需生成文本。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How strong is the evidence that direct scoring, rather than extra training data, drives the gains?
segments.zh: 有多大证据能说明，真正带来提升的是直接打分，而不是额外的训练数据？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors address that with a controlled comparison: VideoJev and an autoregressive Qwen three point five four B model use the same post-training data and single-stage schedule. VideoJev is 1.3 points higher in mean grounding mIoU and 1.9 points higher in mean question-answering score. In broader tests, VideoJev-4B reaches 65.3 mean grounding mIoU and a mean question-answering score of 74.3. Those comparisons suggest the interface contributes, though they do not settle every architectural question.
segments.zh: 作者用一个控制变量对比来回应这一点：VideoJev 和一个自回归的 Qwen 3.5 4B 模型使用相同的后训练数据和单阶段训练计划。VideoJev 在平均 grounding mIoU 上高出 1.3 个点，在平均问答得分上高出 1.9 个点。在更广泛的测试中，VideoJev-4B 达到了 65.3 的平均 grounding mIoU 和 74.3 的平均问答得分。这些对比说明这个接口确实有贡献，但并没有解决所有架构层面的问题。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The reported efficiency is substantial in the tested setup. Grounding latency is 0.276 seconds for VideoJev-4B, compared with 0.763 seconds for its backbone. On L-V-Bench, the measured times are 1.123 seconds for VideoJev-4B and 144.929 seconds for the Qwen three point five Thinking baseline. These measurements include model computation and visual encoding, but exclude preprocessing, transfers, and postprocessing. So they show a meaningful advantage under the stated protocol, not a universal end-to-end guarantee.
segments.zh: 在测试环境下，报告出来的效率提升相当可观。VideoJev-4B的定位延迟是0.276秒，而它的骨干模型是0.763秒。在L-V-Bench上，VideoJev-4B测出来是1.123秒，Qwen 3.5 Thinking基线则是144.929秒。这些测量涵盖了模型计算和视觉编码，但不包括预处理、传输和后处理。所以它们说明的是在所述协议下有明显优势，而不是一个通用的端到端保证。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could confidence scores make these decisions safe to automate?
segments.zh: 置信度分数能让这些决策安全地自动化吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not by themselves. The paper finds that confidence scores can rank stronger predictions, but they are not fully calibrated: the models tend to overestimate correctness. The mean expected calibration error is 8.65 percentage points for VideoJev-4B and 8.13 for the larger model. That distinction matters if an agent must decide when to act or ask for help. A useful ranking signal is not automatically a trustworthy probability, so deployment would need calibration and uncertainty checks.
segments.zh: 光靠它们本身还不够。论文发现，置信度分数可以给更强的预测排序，但它们并没有完全校准：模型往往会高估自己的正确性。VideoJev-4B 的平均期望校准误差是 8.65 个百分点，更大的模型是 8.13。如果智能体必须决定何时行动或何时求助，这个区别就很关键。一个有用的排序信号并不自动等于一个可信的概率，所以部署时还需要校准和不确定性检查。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: For the field, VideoJev shifts attention from generating an answer to defining the right decision interface. That connects with agent research such as LongVideoAgent, which coordinates agents for long-video reasoning, but VideoJev focuses on efficient judgments about a shared visual input. Its experiments cover temporal grounding and multiple-choice questions, using video frames without audio or subtitles. This makes the contribution concrete, while leaving open how well the approach extends to open-ended dialogue or richer multimodal evidence.
segments.zh: 对领域来说，VideoJev把注意力从生成答案转向定义正确的决策接口。这与LongVideoAgent等智能体研究一脉相承，后者协调多个智能体进行长视频推理，但VideoJev聚焦的是对共享视觉输入做出高效判断。它的实验涵盖时序定位和多项选择题，使用的是不带音频或字幕的视频帧。这让贡献变得具体，同时也留下了悬念：这种方法能否很好地扩展到开放式对话或更丰富的多模态证据。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the next test is whether this stays useful with live video and more varied decisions?
segments.zh: 所以接下来的测试就是，它在实时视频和更多样化的决策下是否依然有用？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Yes. Streaming conditions, additional decision types, and better uncertainty handling are important next steps. The question-answering training set is internally curated, and latency depends on the hardware and evaluation protocol, so broader validation would help establish generality. Still, the shared scoring idea offers a clear design option for visual agents: preserve language-conditioned representations, reuse video computation, and expose structured decisions directly. The main takeaway is that an agent does not need to narrate every intermediate judgment to make it.
segments.zh: 是的。流式条件、更多决策类型，以及更好的不确定性处理，都是重要的下一步。问答训练集是内部整理的，延迟取决于硬件和评估协议，所以更广泛的验证有助于确立通用性。不过，共享评分的思路为视觉智能体提供了一个清晰的设计选项：保留语言条件化的表征，复用视频计算，并直接输出结构化决策。主要结论是，智能体不需要把每一个中间判断都说出来，也能做出这些判断。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: VideoJev shows how one model can score both candidate answers and candidate time intervals, while reusing video computation across questions. Its results suggest that this design can improve efficiency and benchmark performance, with important limits around calibration, evaluation scope, and deployment conditions. For researchers, the useful question is not simply whether a model can describe a video, but whether it can make the specific decision a system needs, reliably and at an appropriate cost. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: VideoJev展示了一个模型如何既能给候选答案打分，又能给候选时间段打分，同时在不同问题之间复用视频计算。它的结果表明，这种设计可以提升效率和基准表现，但在校准、评估范围和部署条件方面存在重要局限。对研究者来说，有用的问题不只是模型能否描述一段视频，而是它能否可靠地、以合适的成本做出系统所需的特定决策。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
